title: From HTTP Response to Trustworthy Market Data
utility_use_case: After a market-data research pipeline exports normalized CSV files, reports, and model inputs, run the manifest tool on the build-artifacts directory and retain its JSON output beside the run record. Later, generate a fresh manifest and compare the paths and hashes to find changed or missing files. The inventory helps with reproducibility and artifact review, but it cannot validate quote freshness, data licensing, analytical correctness, or provenance.
